title: skills: encode the review-chain-stall takeover rule (four conditions) into contract-review.md's clear-equals-land section
body:
Provenance: maintainer ruling 2026-08-31 (director seat summon #7, decision batch #17, verbatim 「同意」 on #13758's option B). Ruling record: #13758 comment 5478594239. Filed by the director seat, session `session_01KGtaLpkW1mycWgkbSb3H6t`.

## The rule to encode (ruled text, carry the substance verbatim)

In `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`, the 清标即落地 (clear-equals-land) section gains the stall-takeover clause: when ALL four conditions hold —

1. a review-chain **PASS is on record** (an at-tier verdict comment on the card),
2. `needs:contract-review` is **cleared on both carriers**,
3. the PR's checks are **all green** (every check, ⛔ not the required subset),
4. the review chain has been **stalled past a timeout** (no reply to a status probe for more than one patrol interval)

— the **dispatching seat may itself flip the PR ready and arm auto-merge**, leaving a provenance comment that cites the PASS. Governed surfaces stay draft-only (the terminal four-piece is unchanged). Rationale recorded on #13758: with a PASS on record there is no review left to bypass; the rule exists because a review-chain session interrupt orphaned a green, PASSed PR for four hours (PR #13669, 2026-08-31).

## Boundaries

- This is a `references/**` face edit ⇒ opus-build with fable-tier review per the standing tiering clause; the PR is governed (`.claude/**`) ⇒ draft-only + human merge / pinned-approval queue path.
- ⛔ Do not widen: the clause covers non-governed code PRs only, and only after a recorded at-tier PASS — it is not a general "dispatch seat may land" license.
- Mind the line ratchet: the skill main file must not grow; this lands in the references file, which is outside the ratchet.

Refs: #13758 (the ruled card) · PR #13669 (the incident).
